verdicts.title: Solveig's Song, Op. 55 No. 4 (from Peer Gynt, arr. Sauret)
verdicts.note: A stand-alone violin & piano Solveig's Song is documented for Sauret (New York: Carl Fischer 1902, plate 7492; also in Sauret's Peters Grieg set, Lieder Vol. 1) and for Hubay (Hungaroton, Hubay Vol. 7 transcriptions - may sit on Hubay's list). Sitt's Peters arrangement (ca. 1900) covers the complete Peer Gynt Suite No. 2 for violin or cello and piano, not a separate Solveig's Song. Keep only one arrangement of this piece.

Hans Sitt's violin & piano arrangement of Lyric Pieces Op. 43 No. 6 (Til Foråret / To Spring) exists: C.F. Peters, Leipzig [1892] (selection Nos. 2, 5, 6); also P.L. Jung, New York 1898. Date is 1892, not c.1900.
Hans Sitt's violin & piano arrangement of Lyric Pieces Op. 43 No. 5 (Erotik) exists: C.F. Peters, Leipzig [1892] (Sitt's Peters series of Lyric Pieces, 8 vols 1889-1901).

gaps.title: Ensom vandrer (The Lonely Wanderer), Op. 43 No. 2 (arr. Sitt)
gaps.edition: C.F. Peters, Leipzig [1892] (Sitt's selection of Op. 43 Nos. 2, 5, 6)
gaps.note: Third piece of the same Peters selection as N2/N3. Sitt's complete Peters series (IMSLP 'Lyrische Stücke (Grieg)') also has e.g. Arietta Op. 12/1, Vuggevise Op. 38/1, Melodi Op. 47/3, Halling Op. 47/4, Notturno Op. 54/4, Bryllupsdag Op. 65/6 - not added because no recording evidence.
